title: Zed AFK
description: The Zed AFK Plugin for Minecraft can automatically detect when a player has been idle for a certain amount of time (e.g., 20 to 30 seconds) and then marks them as AFK (Away From Keyboard).
body: The **Zed AFK Plugin** for Minecraft can automatically detect when a player has been idle for a certain amount of **time** (e.g., 20 to 30 seconds) and then marks them as **AFK** (Away From Keyboard).![Sample](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7c1fe5e485b8da8a81dc71bd5afd1a5d6c79450_0.webp)
